notes.title: [Update to Update: 1.1 -> 1.2] Bug-fixing patch: the mushroom is now safe
notes.content:
[Dec 17, 2017]: Second bug-fixing patch.

------------
[Original update]

Hey guys, just updated with a bug-fixing patch! Should be no biggie, but picking up mushroom at one point is no longer a serious matter of concern for getting stuck. 

Also fixed another few places that folks reported bugs at [spoiler](guest house + plane cockpit)[/spoiler], and other minor glitches. Thanks for posting about them!

If any issues come up, please let me know. c: Have a great weekend, and hope y'all enjoy the game.

(P.S. This is for PC version for the time being -- As soon as it looks like all's well, I'll be sending it to Eli who would be able to update the Mac & Linux version with it as well.)
